title: City: maps and the real world
body: Maps, point clouds and GPS, turned into something you can move through: a digital twin of a street, or AR that knows which corner you’re on.

title: Room: games, apps and training sims
body: The things people pick up and play with: games, apps, websites and training sims. It’s where I get to build fast.

title: Chip: tools, AI and backends
body: The part nobody sees: tools, SDKs, computer vision, synthetic data and a backend that keeps running. It makes the other two possible.
